capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.summary: {{ready}} of {{total}} ready. Features appear only where they can work.
capabilities.loadingSummary: What Athena found on this host.

job.working: Working… You can close this; it keeps running.
job.connectionLost: The connection to the job was lost.

restart.title: Restart Athena?
restart.description: Running jobs are stopped. The page reconnects in a few seconds. Your apps keep running.
restart.waitingBody: This page reloads when Athena is back.

action.howTo: {{reason}}. To upgrade, run this on the server (it installs the new version and restarts Athena; your data and settings stay):

interrupted.title: The last update didn't finish
interrupted.body: An update from {{from}} to {{to}} started but never reported back (the host may have lost power, or the update was stopped). Athena is up, but check that it's the version you expect. The update log is in the data folder (logs/update.log). To repair an install, run the installer command from the README on the server.

dialog.stepSwap: Stop Athena, install and start it again
dialog.stepCheck: Wait for the new version to answer
dialog.rolledBackBody: Athena went back to the version you had, with your data as it was before the update.
dialog.failedTitle: Update to {{to}} failed and Athena isn't running
dialog.abortedBody: Nothing was installed. Start Athena again, or run the installer command from the README.
dialog.failedBody: Run the installer command from the README on the server to repair it.
dialog.backBody: Reload the page to see which version is running.
dialog.confirmBody: Athena restarts for a minute or two and the page reconnects. Your apps and containers keep running. If the new version doesn't start, Athena goes back to this one.
dialog.backupFirstHelp: Saves Athena's settings and data with the backup plan “{{plan}}” before anything is stopped. Your apps aren't touched.
dialog.notChanged: {{error}}. Nothing was changed; Athena still runs {{current}}.
dialog.updatingTo: Updating to {{latest}}. This page reloads when Athena is back.
dialog.lateBody: It can take longer on a slow host. If it stays down, check the update log in the data folder (logs/update.log).

restartLateBody: It can take longer on a slow host. If it stays down, check the log in the data folder (logs/athena.log).
